The packaged independent brute-force checker passed twelve finite configurations.

value.rationale: A complete all-r hierarchy is a natural group-theoretic invariant. The formula evaluates a universal spectral framework in all finite chain rings with an unexpectedly two-term support and computes the number A_m(q) of largest-order abelian subgroups. The independence from ring isomorphism and coefficient characteristic is a structural theorem, and the higher r distribution is not a mere pair-count recomputation.
